title.en: Parking Places (Vehicle Removal, Storage and Release Charges) Rules 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Parking Places (Vehicle Removal, Storage and Release Charges) Rules 2018 and come into operation on 8 May 2018.

2. In these Rules —
“HDB parking place” means a parking place that —
(a)is provided by the Authority under section 4 of the Act; and
(b)is operated by the Housing and Development Board;
“URA parking place” means a parking place that —
(a)is provided by the Authority under section 4 of the Act; and
(b)is operated by the Urban Redevelopment Authority.
[S 189/2026 wef 02/04/2026]

heading.en: Charges for vehicle removed, detained or immobilised under section 15(1) of Act from or at HDB parking place
Charges for vehicle removed, detained or immobilised under section 15(1) of Act from or at URA parking place
Removal and storage charges for vehicle removed and detained under section 15(2) of Act

text.en:
5.—(1) Where a vehicle is removed and detained by an enforcement officer under section 15(2) of the Act, the charges that must be paid for the release of the vehicle under section 15(4) of the Act are —
(a)a removal charge at the rate specified in the second column of Part 3 of the Schedule opposite the type of vehicle concerned; and
[S 189/2026 wef 02/04/2026]
(b)a storage charge at the rate specified in the third column of Part 3 of the Schedule for each period of 24 hours or part thereof during which the vehicle is detained.
[S 189/2026 wef 02/04/2026]
[S 189/2026 wef 02/04/2026]
(2) In counting the period a vehicle is detained, the time starts immediately after the end of the day the vehicle is removed or detained, whichever last happens.
[S 189/2026 wef 02/04/2026]
